brief:
France's Senate rejected proposed amendments that would have required holders to declare self-custody cryptocurrency wallets valued at €100,000 or more, Bitcoin Magazine reported. The measure also would have applied to stablecoin holdings meeting the same threshold.

The rejected rule would have expanded financial disclosure requirements for French residents holding digital assets in personal wallets outside regulated exchanges or custodial services.

title: France's Senate rejects Bitcoin self-custody wallet declaration rule
